description: This file is a shell script used for benchmarking and testing different regex engines within git-log's --grep functionality, including generating patterns, calling test_perf to run these comparisons, and verifying that the different engines produce consistent results.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Sets up a large repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_checkout_worktree
methods.description: Prepares a working directory for testing.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs performance tests with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for required prerequisites, such as PCRE support.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expecting successful completion.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
